item.summary: US crypto and data-centre company Galaxy Digital reported net income of 323 million dollars for the third quarter of 2026, after a loss of 85 million dollars in the second quarter. The company attributes the result to its digital-assets business, gains on its investment portfolio and the first full quarter of leasing revenue from its data-centre business.
